'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a utilitarian resource that can only be obtained by mining a [[coal]] vein (though some can be found in a diggable mound near village), after unlocking the required [[Building (Tech Tree)|technology]]. The only accessible vein of coal is located in the far north-west, near the [[Quarry]]. While this is not a 100% consistent method to obtain {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}}, it should appear relatively often.
